scope: m5ui public constructors and documented methods
real firmware LVGL exports, inherited and binding methods

evidence_rules.inheritance: Runtime dir includes inherited public members; pin frozen/binding source to distinguish origin. Missing runtime-only exports remain explicit inventory gaps.

m5ui-lifecycle.isolation: Dedicated program and session lifecycle; never mix live M5UI objects with Widgets/Display rendering.
checks: init and deinit execute
fresh page renders after init
documented repeat lifecycle and same-VM replacement retain control
exceptions and Ctrl-C produce explicit cleanup evidence
construct each class with official parameters
all child/parent/tab/menu/page accessors and mutation methods execute
load, navigate and return through injected touch
all public inherited methods map to a class-appropriate recipe
inspect before/after framebuffer and event log; retain wrong-parent negative control
construct each class
set/get values, ranges, text, options and public inherited styles
inject touch/drag/longpress for each advertised event
state/flag normal, pressed, checked, focused, hidden and disabled behavior
observe rendered result and actual callback data; programmatic set is separate from physical input
construct each class
execute every documented draw, source, series, point, scale and batch method
verify returned pixel/value/series data where supported
image decode uses packaged known-hash resources
inspect fresh framebuffer after each functional group; isolated malformed resource negative control

display-canvas.isolation: Separate program from LVGL and Widgets; reuse offscreen canvas for multi-draw updates.
checks: rotation/size/color-depth/cursor round trips
each documented shape/text/font/QR method
PNG/JPG/BMP/raw buffer decode using known resources
newCanvas creates actual object and inventories all public inherited canvas methods
canvas push gives visible expected primitives, text and colors
actual pixels and bounds verified from fresh frames

widgets.isolation: Separate program from LVGL; widget parent may be a documented canvas.
checks: construct every frozen widget including runtime-only classes absent in skill docs
text/font/color/cursor/size/visibility state and all public inherited methods
packaged image replace and relocation
fresh frames verify values, placement and missing-resource failure
controlled local HTTP fixture for success, timeout, non-2xx and malformed content
update/period/enable/validity/value/JSON-key and inherited methods
timer/IRQ cleanup on deinit and repeated Run
same session network/data-plane and framebuffer evidence
inventory all real module exports and class member sets
distinguish constants/types/functions/read errors
pin binding source to firmware where available
assign every callable a constructor/method/event/render/cleanup recipe before claiming full coverage
binding declarations and dir/help are never functional PASS

candidate_source.binding_rule: Actual guest exports and functional execution must establish correspondence; a build tree is not a firmware identity proof.

open_inventory_gaps: Dynamically created Display Canvas public method set requires object reflection after construction
All native LVGL bindings must be mapped to executable recipes; M5UI docs alone do not enumerate them
Frozen source API versions may differ from current official docs; discrepancies must be classified, never silently dropped
